text: During the CEAMARC oceanographic events in late December 2007 to late January 2008 in the North Atlantic between ~139–150°E and 67–43°S, how did the ship’s surveyed water depth and seafloor slope vary over time, and were there periods where the seafloor transitioned between relatively flat bottom and sloping terrain that could affect benthic habitat interpretation?
expected_titles: 2007-08 V3 CEAMARC-CASO Bathymetry Plots Over Time During Events

text: How does the stratigraphic sequence (e.g., changes in sediment layering and seismic reflection character) beneath the central Arctic Ocean evolve across the region around ~140°E, 88°N during the 2004 ACEX survey window, and what does that imply about the timing and nature of past marine sediment deposition?
expected_titles: ACEX 2004 Seismic

text: How do the Quaternary sedimentary strata geometry and seafloor topography offshore of Long Island (Fire Island to the New York–New Jersey inner shelf) vary along the 1997-09-24 to 1997-10-19 boomer/sparker survey lines, and what seabed features (e.g., bedforms or shallow structure) can be inferred from the seismic profiles?
expected_titles: Archive of Boomer and Sparker Subbottom Data Collected During USGS Cruise DIAN 97032 Long Island, NY, Inner Shelf-Fire Island, NY, September 24-October 19, 1997

text: How do the observed sea-ice floe properties and the surrounding ocean wave conditions co-vary near the Antarctic Peninsula/Drake Passage sector during austral summer to early autumn (late Nov 2016 to mid-March 2017), and does increasing wave forcing coincide with more frequent floe collisions/rafting events near the ice edge?
expected_titles: Antarctic Circumnavigation Expedition 2016-2017: WAMOS data

text: For the December 23, 1854 tsunami, how did coastal sea-surface height and tidal height signals recorded by tide gauges across the Pacific coast (approximately 32.7–37.7°N, 117.2–122.4°W) evolve during 21–27 Dec 1854, and what changes indicate the tsunami arrival relative to the expected tide and tidal currents? Compare the timing and magnitude of the tsunami-related departures from normal tidal patterns among the different gauges within this region.
expected_titles: Archival and Discovery of December 23, 1854 Tsunami Event on Marigrams

text: How do the multi-channel seismic observations in the northern Weddell Sea’s Powell Basin (Antarctica) from mid- to late December 2002 constrain the relationship between regional plate-tectonic structure and sedimentary layering/structures there? Specifically, what seismic stratigraphic features (e.g., reflectors, unconformities, folding or faulting signatures) indicate tectonic deformation during the basin’s geological evolution?
expected_titles: 2002 Seismic Data, Antarctica

text: How did surface water temperature, salinity, and related ocean chemistry and optical properties vary across the Chesapeake Bay over the course of 2004, and were there any consistent spatial patterns between the main bay and its tributaries?
expected_titles: 2004 Measurements made in the Chesapeake Bay

text: How did the seafloor topography and water depths in South San Francisco Bay (including Coyote Creek and Alviso/Mud Sloughs) change between the early 1980s and 2005, and where are the largest bathymetric differences concentrated?
expected_titles: 2005 Hydrographic Survey of South San Francisco Bay, California

text: How does the seafloor bathymetry in Terra Nova Bay near Jang Bogo Station vary spatially across the 2018–2019 survey period, and are there distinct shallow/deep features that could influence local circulation or safe navigation for research vessels?
expected_titles: 2018&19 Multibeam data of Terra Nova Bay (around Jang Bogo station)

text: During the austral summer (late January to mid-March 2017) in the Southern Ocean near the Sub-Antarctic islands, how did observed ocean wave conditions relate to the size and spatial distribution of sea-ice floes near the ice edge?
expected_titles: Antarctic Circumnavigation Expedition 2017: motion sensor and GPS data

text: During the October 2019–January 2020 rain season near Guam (around 14°N, 144°E), how did upper-ocean salinity and temperature structure (e.g., salinity stratification and potential density) evolve in response to episodic tropical rain events as captured by adaptive autonomous seagliders?
expected_titles: Adaptive Sampling of Rain and Ocean Salinity from Autonomous Seagliders (Guam 2019-2020)

text: How do the sedimentary structures preserved in gravity and box cores from the Powell Basin (northern Weddell Sea) reflect the local paleoceanographic and tectonic setting inferred from geophysical profiles collected during the 2004 Antarctic cruise? Specifically, what stratigraphic patterns in late-Quaternary marine sediments suggest changes in depositional environment and basin evolution around the time interval sampled in December 2004?
expected_titles: 2004 Sediment Core, Antarctica

text: How do the seasonal cycles of dissolved carbon dioxide, nutrient availability (major and minor), and carbon export—reflected in biogenic sediment accumulation—vary across the Southern Ocean (e.g., around the Antarctic Circumpolar Current) from the 1970s onward, and do they indicate whether the region acts as a net CO2 source or sink?
expected_titles: An integrated approach to assess carbon dynamics in the Southern Ocean from the Belgian Antarctic Program

text: How did near-bottom ocean currents in the northern Gulf of Mexico continental slope (roughly 300–3000 m depth) vary during 1999–2003, and were there any recurring seasonal or event-driven changes in current speed/direction?
expected_titles: Acoustic doppler current meter data collected in support of the Minerals Management Service-supported Deep Water Program in the the Gulf of Mexico, 1999 - 2003 (NCEI Accession 0002196)

text: In the northwestern Antarctic Peninsula continental shelf, what do the 1997 gravity-core sediment samples and associated seismic observations indicate about the sedimentary structures and depositional environments during that short survey period?
expected_titles: 1997 Sediment Core, Antarctica

text: How have measurements of marine geophysical signals in the North Atlantic (e.g., gravity anomalies and geomagnetic variations) evolved across major tectonic episodes from the 1970s to the present, and do these changes coincide with known earthquake-rich periods in the region?
expected_titles: BAS Geophysical Data - Overview

text: Between August 2020 and July 2023, how did seasonal sea-ice conditions vary in the western Arctic (roughly 90–180°W, 60–90°S) and what concurrent changes are evident in nearby marine sediment characteristics that could indicate shifting ice-driven sediment transport?
expected_titles: 2021 Polar Marine Science GRC and GRS

text: How do the stratigraphic sequence and inferred tectonic structures in the Chukchi Sea (Chukchi Rise) relate to zones of potential seabed methane release based on the multi-channel seismic observations collected during 2–10 September 2019?
expected_titles: ARA10C Multi-Channel Seismic Survey Data

text: How have dissolved ammonia (as ammonia nitrogen), salinity, pH, and dissolved oxygen in the coastal waters near Saint John’s (45–46°N, 66.25–65.25°W) changed over the early 1990s (e.g., 1992–1995), and are there signs of coupled shifts in nutrient and oxygen conditions consistent with changing water quality?
expected_titles: ACAP Saint John's Community Environmental Monitoring Program (CEMP)

text: During the 2007/2008 Antarctic season, how did concentrations and stable-isotope signatures of key nutrient/silicate-related biogeochemical tracers vary across the CEAMARC-CASO cruise area (roughly 139–150°E, 67–43°S), and do surface phytoplankton-derived samples show different isotope/nutrient patterns than CTD-filtered water samples?
expected_titles: 2007-08 V3 CEAMARC-CASO Samples for germanium and boron group

text: Using the marine seismic observations from the northern Weddell Sea (Powell Basin) collected in early December 2000, what evidence is there for the tectonic structure and deformation of seafloor and near-surface sedimentary layers, and how do the observed sedimentary structures relate to regional plate-tectonic processes in the basin?
expected_titles: 2000 Seismic Data, Antarctica

text: How do dissolved barium concentrations and related biogeochemical indicators (e.g., alkalinity, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, oxygen, and silicate) vary over time in the Southern Ocean near Antarctic Bottom Water formation sites between 1985 and 2005, and how are these changes linked to shifts in primary production and carbon/nitrogen cycling?
expected_titles: Barium Biogeochemistry

text: How do the stratigraphic sequences imaged by multi-channel seismic data in the Beaufort Sea (Arctic Ocean) during the 2017-08-27 to 2017-09-16 cruise record evidence of past tectonic deformation and potential pathways or controls on seabed methane release?
expected_titles: ARA08C Multi-Channel Seismic Survey Lines

text: How do magnetic susceptibility variations along the NBP01-01 jumbo piston core transect relate to past changes in Antarctic ocean and climate conditions between the late Pleistocene and Holocene, and do the susceptibility trends show distinct stratigraphic intervals indicative of major glacial–interglacial transitions?
expected_titles: Cruise NBP01-01 Multisensor Track data

text: How do changes in Permian–Triassic climate in the Allan Hills region of South Victoria Land, Antarctica (within ~159–165°E, 84–76°S) appear in the vertical succession of fossil macroplants and associated sediments between the early Permian and late Triassic (as inferred from the stratigraphic record)? Specifically, is there evidence for a shift from cold-wet conditions with forest establishment to a warmer-drier interval that suppresses plant growth, followed by late Triassic moistening and renewed vegetation?
expected_titles: Collaborative Research: Reconstructing the High Latitude Permian-Triassic: Life, Landscapes, and Climate Recorded in the Allan Hills, South Victoria Land, Antarctica

text: How do manganese nodule properties (e.g., composition and mineral characteristics) vary across different locations in the Arctic Ocean seafloor based on samples collected during the 2021 August–September dredging survey?
expected_titles: ARA12C Manganese nodule samples data

text: How do 40Ar/39Ar ages from metamorphic minerals constrain the timing of crustal thickening in the internal Humber zone of the southern Quebec Appalachians (Middle Ordovician) and the subsequent exhumation (Silurian to Early Devonian)? Compare the age distributions across different mineral phases and rock units to test whether thickening and exhumation occurred as distinct tectonometamorphic episodes.
expected_titles: Argon isotopic data for metamorphic minerals in rocks from the southern Quebec Appalachians

text: How did 89 GHz vertically polarized microwave brightness temperature vary over the tropical Pacific (e.g., 10°S–10°N, 120°E–120°W) during the 2003 boreal late-spring to early-autumn period, and are there clear monthly anomalies associated with changes in atmospheric water vapor/cloud liquid water?
expected_titles: ADEOS-II/AMSR L3 89.0GHz-V Mean for Brightness Temperature (1month,0.25deg)

text: How does the monthly mean 36.5 GHz vertically polarized microwave brightness temperature vary over the Arctic Ocean (e.g., 60–90°N) between April and October 2003, and what does that seasonal pattern imply about changes in surface water/sea-ice conditions?
expected_titles: ADEOS-II/AMSR L3 36.5GHz-V Mean for Brightness Temperature (1month,0.25deg)

text: During solar sector boundary crossings between 1995 and 2017, how do global surface pressure anomalies (particularly in the Northern Hemisphere winter/spring) evolve at superposed epoch lags from about −13 to +13 days? Are there systematic pressure residual responses consistent with solar-wind/auroral activity changes in the days surrounding these crossings?
expected_titles: Modified NCEP surface pressure data, key-dates for superposed epoch analyses, and videos of surface pressure responses

text: During geomagnetic storms in the near-Earth magnetotail (geocentric distances ~30–40 Earth radii) from 1974–1980, how do the measured low-energy electron and proton fluxes (5 eV–50 keV) change with particle energy and time, and what corresponding shifts occur in particle density, speed, and temperature?
expected_titles: Interplanetary Monitoring Platform (IMP-8) Low-Energy Proton and Electron Differential Energy Analyzer (LEPEDEA) Data

text: How did ice thickness beneath the Amery Ice Shelf (Antarctica) vary along the 1970–02 traverse, and are there distinct spatial patterns (e.g., thicker ice near certain flow lines) within the surveyed area?
expected_titles: Amery Ice Shelf Ice Depth Radar 1970

text: How did snow grain size (retrieved from reflected 865 nm radiation) evolve across the Northern Hemisphere high latitudes during the winter-to-early-spring period of 2003 (e.g., Jan–Oct), and are there systematic regional differences between continental snowfields and coastal areas?
expected_titles: ADEOS-II/GLI L3 Binned Snow grain size retrieved with 865nm band (1month,1/12deg)
